notes.title: 【PRICE sequel "The Endless Journey" English version released!】
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Here is indie game YETU GAME. Our new puzzle game The Endless Journey English version has released on Steam! The address is:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/715650/The_Endless_Journey/

The timeline of this game is at the Ivry siblings childhood time. They will be the NPC in the game. And this time the protagonist is the magician who appeared in PRICE - Mr. Valjean. Is he a good man or bad?

notes.title: PRICE Design Collection English Version Released + 30% Off!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your support all along. During the Summer Sales, we are releasing:
1. PRICE revised English version; English proofreader: lolaya, German proofreader: Stealth

2. PRICE English Design Collection translated by 三月疯兔子, proofread by Stealth

3. PRICE Japanese version, translated by 悲伤的小鱼

Last year, as Steam newcomers, we made friends with players from all over the world for the very first time. Your kind suggestions have been really helpful. We’ll try to release our up-coming games in both Chinese and English simultaneously (we’re also working hard on other languages!). 

Hope to see you in our new puzzle-solving game, Cosette!
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26300079/4759341e11e654cf8543a941180c7d80b42ce728.png[/img]

notes.title: English Verision v1.3.4 Update
notes.notes:
It has been a big problem that some player could not see the video of game, which is really important for the puzzle.
This Update may can help you to see the video inside the game.
We test it on some players and it works well.
If you got the same problem, please try it.

Thanks for your supporting!

notes.title: Version v1.3.3 Update
notes.notes:
Thanks for your supporting for our game!
This version will fix some BUGS including:

1. Fix the character encoding problem. If you got some problem with character encoding, please try this version.
2. Adding a exit-game button on title scene.

Enjoy your game!
